if: the document is a revised tax invoice referred to in section 31
it is issued under rule 53(1) of the CGST Rules, 2017
then: the revised tax invoice MUST state the nature of the document
note: One mandatory particular of rule 53(1)(c), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.extraction_note: In the source this clause is bracketed and carries footnote marker 119, whose text reads 'Omitted vide Notf no. 03/2019-CT dt. 29.01.2019 wef 01.02.2019'. Whether the clause therefore stands omitted from rule 53(1) is an interpretation this record does not make: see GST-INV-REVISED-TAX-INVOICE.
